message: I run a consulting firm called Birchpath Advisory. Prepare a proposal for Copperbank Logistics covering one discovery workshop at €3,000 and one implementation project at €12,000, both one-time fees. Implementation takes eight weeks across three milestones. Include optional support at €1,500/month, excluded from the committed total. Generate the proposal.

offerings.name: Discovery Workshop
offerings.description: One discovery workshop to define objectives, stakeholders, and success criteria. One-time fee.

offerings.name: Implementation Project
offerings.description: Implementation project delivered over eight weeks across three milestones.

offerings.name: Optional Support (retainer)
offerings.description: Optional monthly support retainer — excluded from the committed total.
